newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 2.39 pct up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 2.39 pct up on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 2.39 percent up on Thursday on short-covering in blue chips and rise in scrips related to global depository receipts (GDRs) owing to the recent devaluation of the rupee, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 31.82 points to end at 1,362.77. Losers beat gainers 123 to 105.

"Heavy short-covering and institutional support helped the index to finish up," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "The rupee devaluation has pushed the prices of GDR-related stocks of PTCL and Hub Power up." PTCL rose 1.15 rupees to 34.25 and Hub Power 1.35 to 30.70. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
